title: fix(runtime)!: the automation write doors judge a flow name over every holder, whatever its package's enable state
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCpddLFmKzR39wJWZpkRMCi)_
Fixes #34145

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

> **BREAKING** only for a composition with no metadata store (no metadata protocol): a package-less `PUT /automation/NAME` or `POST /automation` onto a flow name two packages hold, one of them disabled, after the disable's re-sync withdrew the disabled package's slot, was accepted (`200`) and written into the enabled package's flow. It is now refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, naming every holder, before anything is registered (seat ruling on #34145 R2). Remedy: name the package. The bare write door names none, so save that package's flow through the metadata door with `?package=`, which needs a metadata store. Nothing stored moves, so nothing is migrated (ADR-0087: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`).
>
> **Widening:** `AutomationEngine.getHeldFlow(name)` is a new public method on a class `@objectstack/service-automation` exports from its `.` entry (seat ruling on #34145 R1).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`/automation` 的四个写入口(克隆的新名占用检查、写入被拒后的回填副本、PUT 沿用的凭据、DELETE 的存在性检查)不再读"服务视图"`getFlow`,改读引擎新增的引擎内部方法 `getHeldFlow`(按全部持有者判断,与 `bareFlowKey` 同一规则)。
- 为什么改:PR #34048 之后,唯一持有者的包被停用时 `getFlow` 答"无此流程",这四处问的却是"名字是否被占用/引擎原来持有什么"这类持久问题,答案随包的启停而变(座席裁决 6884403301 修正 7)。
- 风险与回滚:破坏性收窄只在"没有元数据存储"的组合里可见(两个包共有、其中一个停用且槽位已撤回的名字,无包 PUT/POST 由 200 变 409,座席裁决 R2);新增公开方法 `getHeldFlow` 是放宽(裁决 R1)。对"唯一持有者已停用"的流程,四处恢复为上一个发布版的答复(克隆 409、回填原定义、保留凭据、DELETE 答删除)。两个包共有、其中一个停用的名字,在这四处统一答 409 并列出全部持有者(与两包都启用时一致);其中克隆新名由"名称已占用"文案变为该拒绝文案,状态码不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` 的 `heldFlowReader` 及四个调用点(克隆的 `collision`、`registerAndSaveFlow` 的 `held`、`keepStoredFlowCredentials`、`unregisterAndDeleteFlow`);`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts` 的 `getHeldFlow`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/automation-write-doors-durable-34145.test.ts`,预期 13 个用例全部通过;引擎侧 `src/flow-slots-per-package.test.ts` 预期 91 个全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Four `/automation` write doors in `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` asked `getFlow`, the engine's served read, a question whose answer must not move with a package's enable state. After PR #34048, `getFlow` answers `null` for a flow whose only holder's package is disabled while the engine still holds its slot, so those four answers moved with it.

**One reader, beside `bareFlowKey` / `getFlowSlot`.** The engine had no public read of the whole body by bare name over every holder: `getFlowSlot` needs the package, and `bareFlowKey` is private. `AutomationEngine.getHeldFlow(name)` is added beside `getFlowSlot` in `engine.ts` (3 lines of body: `bareFlowKey`, then the slot's flow). It is not on `IAutomationService`, but `AutomationEngine` is exported from the package's `.` entry, so the method is published surface: the widening the declaration names (seat ruling on #34145 R1).

**One runtime helper, `heldFlowReader`, used at all four sites.** It asks the engine's `getHeldFlow`. A service without it (a host composing another engine, which has no package to disable) is asked its `getFlow`, as the clone door already does for `flowCredentialHoldings`. `undefined` when the service offers neither read.

| Site | Read FROM | Read TO |
|---|---|---|
| Clone door, taken-name probe on the new name | `getFlow(NEW)` | `heldFlowReader` |
| `registerAndSaveFlow`, the put-back copy `held` | `getFlow(NAME)` | `heldFlowReader` |
| `keepStoredFlowCredentials`, the carried-forward secret | `getFlow(NAME)` | `heldFlowReader` |
| `unregisterAndDeleteFlow`, the existence probe | `flowIsUnknown` (`getFlow`) plus a second `getFlow` | one `heldFlowReader` read; a service with no read is never "unknown", as before |

What moves, for a flow whose only holder's package is disabled while the engine holds its slot (FROM is `main` since PR #34048; TO is the last release's answer, because #34048 is unreleased):

| Door | FROM | TO |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /automation/SOURCE/clone` with this flow's name as the new name | admitted; the copy is filed in the disabled package's slot | `409`, the door's name-taken answer; nothing registered |
| `POST /automation` or `PUT /automation/NAME` that the engine accepts and the store then refuses | `unregisterFlow(NAME)`: the package's registration is dropped | the held body is registered again |
| `PUT /automation/NAME` whose body leaves out the stored hook secret | nothing carried forward | the stored secret is kept |
| `DELETE /automation/NAME` with no stored row | the engine's registration removed, answered `404` | removed, answered `200 {deleted: true}` |

A name two packages hold, one of them disabled, is refused at these doors `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming every holder, before anything is registered. That is what they answer while both packages are enabled (measured on the engine, below). Before:

- `DELETE` answered the same refusal, raised by `unregisterFlow`.
- The clone's new name got the name-taken `409`.
- The definition writes got the same refusal while the disabled holder's slot was held (`registerFlow` raises it). Once the re-sync had withdrawn that slot, `registerFlow` filed the body in the enabled holder's slot, the store's package-less save refused it `409` naming the packages (`flowWriteRefusal`), and the engine was put back. A composition with no metadata store kept the write (`200`). It is now refused `409`: the narrowing the declaration names (seat ruling on #34145 R2).

Unchanged: the read and run doors (`GET`, trigger, legacy trigger, toggle, runs, and the clone's source probe) keep the served read, so the bare doors still answer as PR #34048 made them. A flow of an enabled package and a name the engine does not hold answer as before.

## Tests

New file `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-write-doors-durable-34145.test.ts` (named by the dispatch order), 13 cases through the real `HttpDispatcher`. The automation service answers `getFlow` and `getHeldFlow` as the engine does for such a flow (engine half measured below):

- Clone: a disabled sole holder's name answers `409` with the same code and message as for an enabled holder, and nothing is registered or saved. A name two packages hold is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both holders. CONTROL: a name the engine does not hold is admitted, registered and saved into the pair package.
- Put-back: `PUT` and `POST /` with the store's save refusing put back the held body, with no `unregisterFlow`. CONTROL: an enabled holder.
- Credentials: a served-form `PUT` keeps the stored secret. CONTROL: enabled kept, explicit replaces.
- `DELETE`: a disabled sole holder is removed and answered `200`. CONTROLs: a shared name is refused `409` and nothing is deleted from the store; enabled `200`; unknown name `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`; a stored row alone is still deleted.
- CONTROL: a service without `getHeldFlow` answers the four doors on `getFlow`.

Engine pin, `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-slots-per-package.test.ts` (claim amended to add it, test only): the `[#33905]` case beside the durable reads asserts `getHeldFlow('solo')` is the slot's body (`getFlowSlot(P1, 'solo')`) while the package is disabled.

The bare served doors' `404`s stay pinned in `automation-addressed-route.test.ts` (`[#33905]`), which passes unchanged on this head.

## Acceptance notes

- **Both seat rulings applied.** R1: `getHeldFlow` is a widening, kept and declared. R2: the no-store composition's package-less write onto such a shared name is a declared narrowing. With a store, the package-less save already refused it `409`, and a packaged base is refused `403` earlier by `refuseUnauthoredFlowWrite`.
- **Pin location.** The dispatch order named a new file. AGENTS.md puts a new pin for a component that has a shared harness file into that file. The runtime domain has per-concern files, not one harness, so the order was followed.

## Verification

Final head: `62fe62378c`. It adds the engine pin (`f71a2dd339`), a second merge of `origin/main` (`ac018c0260`, clean, nothing in the touched files) and the changeset's declarations (`156351f637`, `62fe62378c`) to `5bebde8b61`. The first merge brought PR #34278 (`engine.ts` `inboundHookSlot`, another region) and was clean.

<details><summary>Engine half, measured (scratch test over the real `SchemaRegistry` and `flowNameResolver`, removed)</summary>

- Disabled sole holder: `getFlow('solo')` is `null`. `getHeldFlow('solo')` is the slot's body (`=== getFlowSlot(P1, 'solo')`).
- A package-less `registerFlow('solo', copy)` lands in P1's slot, which is the clone the old probe admitted. `registerFlow('solo', held)` puts the body back. `unregisterFlow('solo')` leaves no slot.
- Unknown name and slot-key spelling: both reads `null`. Enabled sole holder: both reads return the same object.
- Shared `t`, P2 disabled, slot kept: `getFlow` is P1's body. `getHeldFlow`, `registerFlow` (no package) and `unregisterFlow` all raise the same `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, "The flow "t" is held by 2 packages in this environment and the caller names no package: …".
- Shared `t`, P2 disabled and withdrawn (P1 under `P1/t`): `getFlow` is P1's body. `getHeldFlow` raises the same refusal. A package-less `registerFlow` does not throw and lands in P1's slot.
- Shared `t`, both served: `getFlow` and `getHeldFlow` raise the same refusal.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which restores and checks the blob against HEAD; `git diff HEAD` empty after each)</summary>

Both test files import their subject from `src`, so no rebuild is involved. Each mutation puts that site's `getFlow` read back, which is H1's reproduction of `main`:

| # | Site put back on `getFlow` | Red |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | clone taken-name probe | 2 of 13: the disabled sole holder's clone (admitted) and the shared-name clone (the served holder's name-taken answer, no refusal) |
| A2 | put-back copy | 2 of 13: `PUT` and `POST /` (the name withdrawn) |
| A3 | carried-forward credential | 1 of 13: the served-form `PUT` (secret `undefined`) |
| A4 | `DELETE` existence probe | 1 of 13: the disabled sole holder's `DELETE` (`404`) |
| A5 | `getHeldFlow` returns `undefined` (engine, `flow-slots-per-package.test.ts`) | 1 of 91: "expected undefined to be { name: 'solo', label: 'solo', …(6) }" |

</details>
